title: Pylons — Aft Fairing — Ventilated Heat Shield and Thicker Interface Seal
abstract: Installation of a standoff heat shield inside the aft pylon fairing together with a thicker interface seal, stopping the hot gas recirculation that scorches the fairing on Auran-powered aircraft.

sections.planning_reason: Thirty-four occurrences of scorching on the inner face of the aft pylon fairing were reported across a fleet of about 210 Auran-powered aircraft. The original interface seal takes a permanent set after repeated exposure above its rated temperature during high-thrust take-offs in hot conditions; once it has set, the gap opens and exhaust gas recirculates into the fairing cavity. There is no immediate airworthiness effect but the condition drives repeat unscheduled fairing removal, and in four cases it degraded the adjacent drain line.
sections.description: A formed heat shield is installed on the inner face of the fairing skin panel, standing off by 8 mm to create a ventilated air gap. The upper fairing doubler is replaced by an item with the standoff bosses machined in and the lower fairing lug kit is re-worked so that the fairing closes on the thicker seal without preloading the latch. The hinge clevis pins are replaced as a matter of course because they are disturbed.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Open the aft pylon fairing and support it on the maintenance stay. WARNING: THE FAIRING IS HEAVY AND WILL SWING WHEN THE LATCHES ARE RELEASED. Do AMM-S-54-50-13-000-008-A to remove the fairing from the pylon. Remove the upper fairing doubler JAR270491-60 from the fairing skin panel D5450133608027 and clean the inner face. Install the new doubler with the standoff bosses and check the standoff dimension at each boss. Install the heat shield onto the bosses with countersunk screws EN962457-4D and washers AES161398-12 to the torque given in the accomplishment instructions. Re-work the lower fairing lug kit ROD165267-21 to the dimension on the modification drawing. Install the thicker interface seal and check the compression at six points around the interface. Replace the hinge clevis pins EN169671-8B. Do AMM-S-54-50-13-400-008-A to install the fairing. Close the fairing and check the latch load with the spring balance. Do a ground run and inspect the interface for witness marks. Record the embodiment.
sections.effectivity_note: Applicable to Auran-powered SLN-30R3 and SLN-34R3 aircraft delivered before the production cut-in at MSN S01466. Aircraft from that MSN onward already have the ventilated shield. Aircraft with the other engine option have a different fairing interface and are not affected.
sections.material_note: Kit K5450-1013-01 contains the heat shield, the machined doubler, the thicker seal, the fastener set and the clevis pins, and covers one pylon; two kits are needed per aircraft. Lead time is fourteen weeks. The removed doubler is scrapped locally.

type_data.compliance_time: At the next scheduled A-check, or within 24 months after the date of this Service Bulletin, whichever occurs first.
